$Comment: What every weapon Focus shares, in no set of its own: a weapon Focus row names it as its Parent. Kind is the
oath set's kind (TrackStances/MMOSkillTree/Mmo_Focus.json: at most one weapon sworn, 25 max Health while it
stands). Line is the weapon's own damage type, never the every-type DamageBonus (which would also count on a
spell cast with the weapon in hand); a bow or a bomb writes DamageBonus_Projectile on its own row. The line
counts only while what you hold trains the Holder skill or on a hit that earns its XP (MmoWeaponSkill). The
Path's guard face is Physical and Projectile resistance, both, at PathGuard each.
LineBound, LinePlain, GuardPlain and GuardPair say which grant list the step generator writes for this kind
(Grants) and which it leaves out ($Comment, which the game ignores): a weapon's line is bound to its weapon, its
guard is the two resistances. Leave them as they are; the step generator's own comment says why.
